approval_checklist: Owner accepts or rejects each candidate ID and family assignment.
Qualified rights review records EU/Polish/Spain jurisdiction, author dates, edition/editor/translator/illustration exclusions and attribution.
Owner authorizes exact official access routes and staging location; no gated access.
First authorized download is bounded by 10 MiB raw UTF-8 and per-item 2.5 MiB caps; SHA-256 is pinned before immutable local snapshot.
Training, raw redistribution and weight redistribution are decided separately; metadata evidence is not clearance.
Tokenizer package/version qualification and train-only fitting approval is separate from corpus access.
If the chosen families exceed 10 MiB, select/remove a family before acquisition; never truncate a work.
residual_risks: Standard Ebooks provides U.S. public-domain warnings, not EU/Polish/Spain clearance.
Wolne Lektury metadata has no immutable revision/checksum; checksums must be pinned on first authorized download.
Editorial annotations/motifs, translations, prefaces and illustrations may require exclusion or separate licensing.
Four Standard Ebooks author life dates remain unresolved in item metadata and require authority-record verification; the five Polish author dates are taken from official Wolne Lektury item pages.
Canonical literary works may overlap evaluation benchmarks; exact/near benchmark checks are required before training.
A feasibility pilot cannot establish balanced production proportions or evaluation quality.
